correctness.rationale: Full-dimensional type-B deformations are invariant under W_n Minkowski averaging. r of a Minkowski sum is at least the sum of inradii, R at most sum of circumradii; Q averaged over W_n is a signed-permutation orbit polytope Q(b), b_1≥...≥b_n≥0. Its signed-majorization inequalities yield r=min_k B_k/√k, and R=||b||₂ by centered symmetric orbit. Normalize r=1; B_k≥√k and d_k=√k−√(k−1) strictly decreasing, so d·b=Σ(d_k−d_{k+1})B_k≥Σd_k²=D_n, while d·b≤√D_n||b||. Equality b=d; all 3^n−1 signed subset facets tangent; D_n=(1/4)log n+O(1). Independent n=2..12 numeric comparison to nonoptimal b_k=1/k corroborated; not proof.

evidence: General Coxeter deformation cones and bisubmodular theory include this polytope family but optimize combinatorial/fan criteria rather than the metric r/R.
